foodDrinks.question: Do you offer any additional food or drinks?
foodDrinks.answer: Yes, we offer a catering menu and drinks that can be prepared per request and quoted as requested.

transportation.question: Do you offer transportation to the departure site?
transportation.answer: Yes, we offer transportation services at an additional cost. We also recommend checking with your hotel to compare for the ideal option.
transportation.rates: For clients staying in Punta Cana and booking a boat in Casa de Campo, the round-trip transport service rate is $250 up to 14 passengers, $375 up to 35 passengers.

casaDeCampoMarina.question: What is the Casa de Campo Marina?
casaDeCampoMarina.answer: Casa de Campo Marina is an exclusive gated community located within the renowned Casa de Campo Resort in La Romana, Dominican Republic. To access the marina, all visitors must pass through the resort's main security checkpoint, where identification and the purpose of the visit will be verified. To facilitate entry, a clear photo of your passport is required in advance so that visitor access can be registered with resort security.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.metaDescription: Cancellation policies, payment terms, and charter conditions for Punta Cana Yacht Charting.

policies.threeDays: If the cancellation is 3 or more days before the contracted date, the Company will refund 100% of the payment.
policies.oneToTwoDays: If the cancellation happens 1 to 2 days before the contracted date, the Company will refund 50% of the payment.
policies.sameDay: If the cancellation is the same day as the contracted date, the client must pay in full.
policies.naturalPhenomena: If the cancellation is due to a severe natural phenomena excluding rain or because of the prohibition of the Dominican Navy, the Company will return the 100% deposit.
policies.holiday: If the cancellation is during a holiday, the client will be charged 100% of the deposit. From Dec 24 to Jan 7 and Holy Week are all holidays.
policies.rescheduling: Rescheduling can be coordinated in the event of severe rain where deemed unable to charter by the navy.
